Typical doses (expressed as the base) are 20 to 40 mg by mouth three or four times daily. It may also be given by slow intravenous or intramuscular injection in doses of 40 to 80 mg. Caroverine has also been given rectally. It is also used in cerebral circulatory disorders and in tinnitus. ◊ References. 1. Denk DM, et al.
